title: Requests per minute by method
intro: The product team thinks in per-minute numbers. Show requests per minute, split by HTTP method.

objectives.text: Show requests per minute, one series per method

hints: increase() gives the total growth over the range, not a per-second value.
debrief: increase(x[1m]) is just rate(x[1m]) * 60. Use whichever reads more naturally to your audience.
